definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 5-7-2018
-- Description:	Get QR code keys
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[getEncyrptedQrCodeValue]
(
	@childID INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @encryptionKey VARCHAR(50) = '[SQL literal withheld]';
	DECLARE @encyptedKey VARBINARY(100);
	
	DECLARE @encyptedTEXT VARCHAR(100);
		
	--SELECT @encyptedKey = EncryptByPassPhrase(@encryptionKey, CONCAT(child_id,'_',Parent.parent_id,'_',center_id))
	SELECT @encyptedTEXT = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),HashBytes('MD5', CONCAT(child_id,'_',Parent.parent_id,'_',center_id)),2)
	FROM Child INNER JOIN Parent ON Parent.parent_id = child.parent_id 
	WHERE child_id = @childID AND ISNULL(child.deleted,0) <> 1 AND ISNULL(parent.deleted,0) <> 1

	
-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @encyptedTEXT
	--RETURN CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),@encyptedKey,2)

	
END

name: getMonthYearLastDate
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-7-2017
-- Description:	Get the last date from an input of month & year
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[getMonthYearLastDate]
(
	 @month INT
	,@year  INT

)
RETURNS DATE

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @requestedDate	DATE;
	DECLARE @currentDate	DATE = GETDATE();

	IF @month <> -1 AND @year <> -1
		BEGIN
			SET @requestedDate =  EOMONTH (CAST( CAST(@month AS VARCHAR) + '[SQL literal withheld]'  + CAST(@year AS VARCHAR) AS DATE));
			IF @requestedDate > @currentDate
				SET @requestedDate =  @currentDate;
		END
	ELSE
		SET @requestedDate =  @currentDate;
	

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @requestedDate
	
END

name: iCareAdmin_addCareCenter
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 9-23-2019
-- Description:	Add Care center
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_addCareCenter]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@name				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@email				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@landline			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@mobile			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@website			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@domain			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@logo				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@photo				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@description		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@address			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@location			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@manager			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@type				INT
	,@currency			INT
	,@academicYearID	INT

	-- User Data
	,@userName			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@password			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@firstName			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@lastName			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@userEmail			NVARCHAR(MAX) 


	,@centerID			INT = -1 OUTPUT
	,@updateStatus		INT = -1 OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY 

		BEGIN TRANSACTION

		-- Add the center info
		INSERT INTO dbo.Care_Center (center_name,center_description,center_address,center_location,center_mobile
								,center_land_line,center_email,center_website,center_logo,center_photo,center_manager,type,center_currency) 
	    VALUES (@name,@description,@address,@location,@mobile,@landline,@email,@website,@logo,@photo,@manager,@type,@currency)
	
		SELECT @centerID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
		-- Add a generated academic year for the inserted center
		INSERT INTO dbo.Center_Academic_Year_Generated (center_id,academic_year_id,academic_year_generated_type,creation_date)
		VALUES (@centerID,@academicYearID,1,GETUTCDATE())
	
		-- Set the active academic year
		INSERT INTO dbo.Active_Academic_Year(center_id,academic_year_id)
		VALUES (@centerID,@academicYearID)
		
		-- Add the notification icons data
		INSERT INTO dbo.[Status](status_logo,center_id,status_description, status_order, deleted)
			SELECT        status_logo,@centerID,status_description,status_order, deleted
			FROM          [dbo].[Status]
			WHERE        (center_id = -1) AND ISNULL(deleted,0) <> 1

		-- SET by default the new center input type as QR Code
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Center_Child_Input_Type] (center_id,input_type_id) VALUES (@centerID,3)
		
		-- Add center Variables
		EXEC icare_secure.dbo.iCareAdmin_addCenterVariables @dealerID,@centerID,@type,@domain

		-- Add center user
		DECLARE @userStatus INT
		EXEC dbo.[iCareAdmin_addCenterUser] @centerID,@userName,@password,@firstName,@lastName,@userEmail,@userStatus OUTPUT

		If @userStatus = 1
			BEGIN
				COMMIT TRANSACTION
				SELECT @updateStatus = 1
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
				SELECT @updateStatus = -1
			END
	END TRY 

	BEGIN CATCH
	    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;


		SELECT @updateStatus = -1
	END CATCH;
	
END

name: iCareAdmin_addCenterUser
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 7-4-2019
-- Description:	Create a default admin user for center
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_addCenterUser]
	
		 @centerID		INT  
		,@userName		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@password		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@firstName		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@lastName		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@email			NVARCHAR(MAX) 
		,@updateStatus  INT = 0 OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY 

		BEGIN TRANSACTION

		--Create the user
	    INSERT INTO sec_users (Username,Password,Firstname,Lastname,Email,classes_full_access,center_id)
		VALUES (@userName,@password,@firstName,@lastName,@email,1,@centerID)
	
		DECLARE @userID INT
		SELECT @userID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
	
		-- Link user to center
		INSERT INTO secCareCenterUser (center_id,UserID)
		VALUES (@centerID,@userID)
	
		--Create a default admin role   
		INSERT INTO dbo.Sec_Roles(Name,Description,center_id) 
		VALUES ('[SQL literal withheld]','[SQL literal withheld]',@centerID)
	
		DECLARE @roleID INT 
		SELECT @roleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
	
		-- Link the user to his new created role
		INSERT INTO dbo.Sec_UserRoles(UserID,RoleID) VALUES(@userID,@roleID)
	            
		DECLARE @centerType INT ;
		SELECT  @centerType = type FROM dbo.Care_Center WHERE center_id = @centerID
	
		-- Add the default pages to the old table [This needs to be removed over time]
		INSERT INTO dbo.System_Role_Menu(menuid,roleid)
		SELECT menuID,@roleID FROM dbo.System_Menus WHERE centertype = @centerType
	
		-- Add the default pages for the requested center type and link to the newly created role
		INSERT INTO dbo.System_Role_Menu_Web(menuid,roleid) 
		SELECT menuID,@roleID FROM dbo.System_Menus_New WHERE centertype = @centerType
	
		EXEC icare_secure.dbo.addNewCenterUser   @userID,@userName,@centerID,@centerType,@password,1
	
		COMMIT TRANSACTION

		SELECT @updateStatus = 1
	END TRY 

	BEGIN CATCH
	    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

		SELECT @updateStatus = -1
	END CATCH;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCenterChildren]
	
	  @centerID			INT
	 ,@dealerID			INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT child_id,child_name 
	FROM dbo.Child children INNER JOIN dbo.Parent parent ON children.parent_id = parent.parent_id 
	WHERE center_id = @centerID  AND ISNULL(parent.deleted,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(children.deleted,0) = 0


END

definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-2-2017
-- Description:	Get Center class children list
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCenterClassChildren]
	
	 @centerID			INT
	,@classID			INT
	,@academicYearID	INT = -1

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	SELECT dbo.Child.child_id,is_Demo,child_name 
	FROM dbo.Child 
		INNER JOIN dbo.Class_Child  ON dbo.Class_Child.Child_ID = dbo.Child.child_id
		INNER JOIN dbo.Parent		ON dbo.Parent.parent_id		= dbo.Child.parent_id
		INNER JOIN dbo.Class		ON dbo.Class_Child.Class_ID = dbo.Class.class_id AND (academic_year_id = @academicYearID OR @academicYearID = -1)
	WHERE dbo.Class_Child.Class_ID= @classID  AND dbo.Class.center_id = @centerID
		AND ISNULL(dbo.Child.deleted,0)		<> 1 
		AND ISNULL(dbo.parent.deleted,0)	<> 1 
		AND ISNULL(dbo.Class.deleted,0)		<> 1 
		
		
END

name: iCareAdmin_getCenterClassesData
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-2-2017
-- Description:	Get Center classes info with student counts
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCenterClassesData]
	
	 @centerID			INT
	,@academicYearID	INT = -1

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	

	SELECT  dbo.Care_Center.center_name, dbo.Class.class_name, COUNT(dbo.Class_Child.Child_ID) AS Student, dbo.Class.class_logo, dbo.Class.center_id, dbo.Class.class_id
	FROM     dbo.Class_Child 
			INNER JOIN dbo.Class		ON dbo.Class_Child.Class_ID = dbo.Class.class_id  AND (academic_year_id = @academicYearID OR @academicYearID = -1)
			INNER JOIN dbo.Care_Center	ON dbo.Class.center_id		= dbo.Care_Center.center_id 
			INNER JOIN dbo.Child		ON dbo.Class_Child.Child_ID = dbo.Child.child_id 
			INNER JOIN dbo.Parent		ON dbo.Parent.parent_id		= dbo.Child.parent_id 
	WHERE dbo.Care_Center.center_id = @centerID 
		AND ISNULL(dbo.Child.deleted,0)		<> 1
		AND ISNULL(dbo.Class.deleted,0)		<> 1
		AND ISNULL(dbo.Parent.deleted,0)	<> 1
	GROUP BY dbo.Class.class_name, dbo.Class.class_logo, dbo.Care_Center.center_name, dbo.Class.center_id, dbo.Class.class_id 
	ORDER BY dbo.Care_Center.center_name, dbo.Class.class_name 

END

name: iCareAdmin_getChildLatestActivationTransactions
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-2-2017
-- Description:	Get child latest activation transactions including addition, activation and deactivation 
--				inorder to conclude the number of active days per month used for billing
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getChildLatestActivationTransactions]
	 
	  @childID			INT
	 ,@requestMonth		INT = -1
	 ,@requestYear		INT = -1


AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @requestedDate	DATE = dbo.getMonthYearLastDate(@requestMonth,@requestYear);
		
	SELECT child_id,transaction_code, transaction_date,CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),transaction_date,101) as trans_date,
		'[SQL literal withheld]' AS this_month 
		FROM dbo.Child_Transactions WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	DATEPART(m, transaction_date) = DATEPART(m, @requestedDate) 
			AND DATEPART(yyyy, transaction_date) = DATEPART(yyyy, @requestedDate) AND child_id = @childID 
			AND (transaction_code =1 OR transaction_code =2 OR transaction_code =3)
	UNION
		SELECT child_id, transaction_code, transaction_date,CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),transaction_date,101) AS trans_date,
		'[SQL literal withheld]' AS this_month 
		FROM (
				SELECT child_id,transaction_code, transaction_date,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY transaction_date DESC) '[SQL literal withheld]'
				FROM dbo.Child_Transactions WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE	transaction_date < DATEADD(d, -DATEPART(d,@requestedDate), @requestedDate) AND child_id = @childID
                 AND (transaction_code =1 OR transaction_code =2 OR transaction_code =3)
			) AS Tab
		WHERE rowRank = 1
	ORDER BY transaction_date

END

name: iCareAdmin_resetCenterAlertMessage
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 2-26-2021
-- Description:	Reset selected centers alert messages
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_resetCenterAlertMessage]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@centersList		dbo.Element_ID_List READONLY
	,@updateStatus		INT  = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	

	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT = [icare_secure].[dbo].[isDealerSuperAdmin](@DealerID)
		IF @isAdmin = 1 
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY 

					BEGIN TRANSACTION
					
					DECLARE @centersTable TABLE (center_id INT, center_type INT)
						INSERT INTO @centersTable
						SELECT center_id,[type] 
						FROM [dbo].[Care_Center] centers INNER JOIN @centersList  centersList ON centersList.ID = centers.center_id

					DELETE FROM [dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] 
					WHERE center_id IN (SELECT center_id FROM @centersTable)


					DECLARE @centerID INT,@centerType INT; -- used as an index for looping
					WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @centersTable) > 0
						BEGIN  
							SELECT TOP(1) @centerID = center_id,@centerType = center_type FROM @centersTable 
							EXEC [icare_log].[dbo].[record_centerAlertMessageUpdates]  @centerID,@centerType,@dealerID,'[SQL literal withheld]'
							DELETE FROM @centersTable WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type  = @centerType
						END  

					COMMIT TRANSACTION;
					SELECT @updateStatus = 1
				END TRY 

				BEGIN CATCH
					IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

					SELECT @updateStatus = -1
				END CATCH;
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @updateStatus = 0
			END
	
	    
END

name: iCareAdmin_updateCenterAlertMessage
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 4-10-2018
-- Description:	set/modify the center alert messages
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterAlertMessage]
	
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@messageText		NVARCHAR(250)
	,@messageExpiryDate	DATE
	,@centersList		dbo.Element_ID_List READONLY
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT = [icare_secure].[dbo].[isDealerSuperAdmin](@DealerID)

	BEGIN TRY 
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
		
		DECLARE @currentDate DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		DECLARE @centersTable TABLE (center_id INT, center_type INT)
		INSERT INTO @centersTable
			SELECT center_id,[type] 
			FROM [dbo].[Care_Center] centers INNER JOIN @centersList  centersList ON centersList.ID = centers.center_id

		UPDATE  alerts
		SET alerts.dealer_id = @dealerID, alerts.message_text = @messageText,alerts.alert_expiry_date = @messageExpiryDate,alerts.update_time = @currentDate
		FROM [dbo].Center_Alert_Message alerts INNER JOIN @centersTable centers ON alerts.center_id = centers.center_id

	    -- Add columns that has no data
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Center_Alert_Message](center_id,message_text,alert_expiry_date,dealer_id,update_time)
			SELECT centers.center_id,@messageText,@messageExpiryDate,@dealerID,@currentDate
			FROM @centersTable centers LEFT JOIN [dbo].Center_Alert_Message alerts ON alerts.center_id = centers.center_id
			WHERE alerts.center_id  IS NULL

		--== Logging
		DECLARE @centerID INT,@centerType INT; -- used as an index for looping
		WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @centersTable) > 0
			BEGIN  
				SELECT TOP(1) @centerID = center_id,@centerType = center_type FROM @centersTable 
				EXEC [icare_log].[dbo].[record_centerAlertMessageUpdates]  @centerID,@centerType,@dealerID,'[SQL literal withheld]',@messageText,@messageExpiryDate
				DELETE FROM @centersTable WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type  = @centerType
			END  


		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		RETURN  1
	END TRY 

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		RETURN -1
	END CATCH;

END

name: iCareAdmin_updateCenterInfo
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 9-24-2019
-- Description:	Update care center info
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterInfo]
	 @dealerID		INT
	,@centerID		INT
	,@name			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@email			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@landline		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@mobile		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@website		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@description	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@address		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@manager		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@inputType		INT
	,@updateStatus	INT = -1 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY
		UPDATE dbo.Care_Center SET  
			 center_name			= @name
			,center_description		= @description
			,center_address			= @address
			,center_mobile			= @mobile
			,center_land_line		= @landline
			,center_email			= @email
			,center_website			= @website
			,center_manager			= @manager
		WHERE center_id = @centerID

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Center_Child_Input_Type WHERE center_id = @centerID)
			BEGIN 
				UPDATE Center_Child_Input_Type SET input_type_id = @inputType WHERE center_id = @centerID
            END
		ELSE
			BEGIN 
				INSERT INTO Center_Child_Input_Type (center_id,input_type_id) VALUES (@centerID,@inputType)
			END
		

		SELECT @updateStatus = 1

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH  
		 SELECT @updateStatus = 0
	END CATCH; 
	
END

name: spGenerateChildQrCode
definition:
CREATE proc [dbo].[spGenerateChildQrCode]
 @child_id AS INT,
 @qrcode as NVARCHAR(MAX) output
as 

DECLARE @id INT; 
DECLARE @input_type INT = 3; 

SELECT @qrcode = dbo.[Getencyrptedqrcodevalue](@child_id) 

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * 
               FROM   child_inputs 
                      INNER JOIN qr_code 
                              ON child_inputs.input_id = qr_code.qr_code_id 
                                 AND child_inputs.input_type = @input_type 
               WHERE  child_id = @child_id) 
  BEGIN 
      INSERT INTO qr_code 
                  (qr_value) 
      SELECT @qrcode  

      SELECT @id = Scope_identity(); 

      INSERT INTO child_inputs 
                  (child_id, 
                   input_id, 
                   input_type) 
      SELECT @child_id, 
             @id, 
             @input_type 
  END
